flags.note: Not either unmatched known issue: p2 is the Strome testimonial in Post 3 (C1) and p3 is the 'will never force a client to sell at a loss' absolute claim (C6) — an adjacent but separate sentence. The flagged text stands on its own under C5: 'when we ran our reserve rules through every rolling 25-year retirement since 1928' is backtested/model performance applied to historical data, reported with a specific outcome statistic (64 of 74 periods), yet the draft gives no withdrawal rate, no portfolio composition for either the reserve or no-reserve case, no refill-rule specifics, no treatment of fees/taxes/costs, no data source, and no statement that results are hypothetical and achieved by no client. It also does not disclose that the 74 rolling windows heavily overlap, which overstates the independence of the evidence. The standard footer's generic 'past performance' and 'investing involves risk' language does not supply model criteria, assumptions, risks or limitations and does not cure C5. Minor caveat: the flag cites survivorship bias, which is not the apt limitation for a single-market rolling-window study — overlapping periods and unstated assumptions are the real gaps — but the text and code identified are correct and warrant reviewer attention.
